 "data": "stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> Submitted : Mission Created & Submitted

 state Submitted <<choice>>
 Submitted --> FAILED : [activeMission != null OR !agent.canPerform(this) OR !checkAvailableResources() OR Env Restriction]
 Submitted --> ASSIGNED : [All validation checks pass in submitMission()]

 ASSIGNED --> IN_PROGRESS : startMission() [Assigns agents, deducts resources, locks equipment]
 ASSIGNED --> FAILED : startActiveMission() fails validation

 state IN_PROGRESS {
 [*] --> Executing
 Executing --> Executing : advanceTime(1) [timeElapsed < requiredDuration & Env Valid]\n/ timeElapsed++, agent battery/fatigue updated
 }

 IN_PROGRESS --> COMPLETED : advanceTime(1) [timeElapsed >= requiredDuration]\n/ complete(), unassign(agents), unlock equipment, removeActiveMission()
 IN_PROGRESS --> FAILED : [Dust Storm on Exploration OR Comm Disruption on Rescue OR RoverBreakdown]\n/ fail(reason), unassign(agents), unlock equipment, removeActiveMission()

 COMPLETED --> [*]
 FAILED --> [*] : Terminal State (Cannot be retried)",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
